test_title: PYST 50: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some batteries are torches.

All clocks are torches.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some batteries are clocks.

(II) All torches are clocks.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some batteries are torches.

All clocks are torches.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c2676bff1410dce96414f51b4d9c7f6b13783dfffa1ad3d483d51434c4d85d9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some batteries are clocks → Does not follow (Although some batteries are torches and all clocks are torches, there is no definite information that batteries overlap with clocks.)

II. All torches are clocks → Does not follow (The statement says "All clocks are torches," which means Clocks are a subset of Torches. It does not mean that all Torches are Clocks.)

So, neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
